heroHeadline: Pakistan Strikes Kunar and Helmand; UN Documents At Least 10 Civilian Deaths
heroSubtitle: Pakistan said its October 1 air strikes hit TTP and Balochistan Liberation Army camps in Kunar and Helmand, claiming 22 fighters killed. The Taliban say at least 9 civilians died, while UNAMA documented at least 10 civilian deaths, mostly children, and 9 injured. The strikes follow Pakistan's September 24 raids and Kabul's September 30 claim of 41 militants killed crossing from Pakistan.
